name: CanvasSpace
comment:
CanvasSpace is an implementation of the abstract class [`Space`](#link). It represents a space for HTML Canvas.
Learn more about the concept of Space in [this guide](../guide/Space-0500.html).

signatures.comment: Create a CanvasSpace which represents a HTML Canvas Space

parameters.name: elem
parameters.comment:
Specify an element by its "id" attribute as string, or by the element object itself. An element can be an existing ``, or a `
` container in which a new `` will be created. If left empty, a `
` will be added to DOM. Use css to customize its appearance if needed.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.comment: an optional callback `function(boundingBox, spaceElement)` to be called when canvas is appended and ready. Alternatively, a "ready" event will also be fired from the `<canvas>` element when it's appended, which can be traced with `spaceInstance.canvas.addEventListener("ready")`

accessors.name: autoResize
accessors.comment: Set whether the canvas element should resize when its container is resized.

parameters.name: auto
parameters.comment: a boolean value indicating if auto size is set

accessors.name: background
accessors.comment: Set a background color for this canvas. Alternatively, you may use `clear()` function.

parameters.name: bg
parameters.comment: background color as hex or rgba string

accessors.name: center
accessors.comment: The center of this space's bounding box.

accessors.name: ctx
accessors.comment: Get the rendering context of canvas

accessors.name: customRendering
accessors.comment: Set a custom rendering function `fn(graphics_context, canvas_space)` if needed.

accessors.name: hasOffscreen
accessors.comment: Check if an offscreen canvas is created

accessors.name: height
accessors.comment: The height of this space's bounding box.

accessors.name: innerBound
accessors.comment: The inner bounding box of the space, excluding its positions.

accessors.name: isPlaying
accessors.comment: Indicate whether the animation is playing.

accessors.name: offscreenCtx
accessors.comment: Get the rendering context of offscreen canvas (if created via `setup()`)

accessors.name: outerBound
accessors.comment: The outer bounding box which includes its positions.

accessors.name: parent
accessors.comment: Get the parent element that contains the canvas element

accessors.name: pixelScale
accessors.comment: `pixelScale` property returns a number that let you determine if the screen is "retina" (when value >= 2)

accessors.name: pointer
accessors.comment: Get the mouse or touch pointer that stores the last action.

accessors.name: ready
accessors.comment: A property to indicate if the Space is ready

accessors.name: size
accessors.comment: The size of this space's bounding box.

accessors.name: width
accessors.comment: The width of this space's bounding box.

signatures.comment:
Add an [`IPlayer`](#link) object or a [`AnimateCallbackFn`](#link) callback function to handle events in this Space. An IPlayer is an object with the following callback functions:
- required: `animate: fn( time, ftime, space )`
- optional: `start: fn(bound, space)`
- optional: `resize: fn( size, event )`
- optional: `action: fn( type, x, y, event )`
Subclasses of Space may define other callback functions.

parameters.name: p
parameters.comment: an [`IPlayer`](#link) object with animate function, or a callback function `fn(time, ftime)`.

signatures.comment: Bind event listener in canvas element. You can also use [`MultiTouchSpace.bindMouse`](#link) or [`MultiTouchSpace.bindTouch`](#link) to bind mouse or touch events conveniently.

parameters.name: evt
parameters.comment: an event string such as "mousedown"

parameters.name: callback
parameters.comment: callback function for this event

parameters.name: options
parameters.comment: options for [addEventListener](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/EventTarget/addEventListener).

parameters.name: customTarget
parameters.comment: an optional event target to use instead of the canvas element

signatures.comment:
Bind or unbind keyboard events. Events are attached to `document` by
default, or to `customTarget` when one is provided.

A convenient method to bind (or unbind) all mouse events in canvas element.
All [`IPlayer`](#link) objects added to this space that implement an `action` callback property will receive mouse event callbacks.
The types of mouse actions are defined by [`UIPointerActions`](#link) constants: "up", "down", "move", "drag", "drop", "over", and "out".

parameters.name: bind
parameters.comment: a boolean value to bind mouse events if set to `true`. If `false`, all mouse events will be unbound. Default is true.

parameters.name: customTarget
parameters.comment: an optional event target to use instead of the canvas element

signatures.comment:
A convenient method to bind (or unbind) all touch events in canvas element.
All [`IPlayer`](#link) objects added to this space that implement an `action` callback property will receive touch event callbacks.
The types of mouse actions are defined by [`UIPointerActions`](#link) constants: "up", "down", "move", "drag", "drop", "over", and "out".

parameters.name: bind
parameters.comment: a boolean value to bind touch events if set to `true`. If `false`, all mouse events will be unbound. Default is true.

parameters.name: passive
parameters.comment: a boolean value to set passive mode, ie, it won't block scrolling. Default is false.

parameters.name: customTarget
parameters.comment: an optional event target to use instead of the canvas element

signatures.comment: Clear the canvas with its background color. Overrides Space's `clear` function.

parameters.name: bg
parameters.comment: Optionally specify a custom background color in hex or rgba string, or "transparent". If not defined, it will use its `bgcolor` property as background color to clear the canvas.

signatures.comment: Similiar to `clear()` but clear the offscreen canvas instead

parameters.name: bg
parameters.comment: Optionally specify a custom background color in hex or rgba string, or "transparent". If not defined, it will use its `bgcolor` property as background color to clear the canvas.

signatures.comment: Dispose of browser resources held by this space and remove all players. Call this before unmounting the canvas.
Get a new `CanvasForm` for drawing
Set a minimum frame time

parameters.name: ms
parameters.comment: at least this amount of milliseconds must have elapsed before frame advances

signatures.comment: Pause the animation.

parameters.name: toggle
parameters.comment: a boolean value to set if this function call should be a toggle (between pause and resume)

signatures.comment:
Main play loop. This implements `window.requestAnimationFrame` and calls it recursively.
You may override this `play()` function to implement your own animation loop.

parameters.name: time
parameters.comment: current time

signatures.comment: Main animation function.

parameters.name: time
parameters.comment: current time

signatures.comment: Play animation loop once. Optionally set a `duration` time to play for that specific duration.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.comment: a value in millisecond to specify a time period to play before stopping, or `-1` to play forever

signatures.comment: Get a [`MediaRecorder`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MediaRecorder) to record the current CanvasSpace. You can then call its `start()` function to start recording, and `stop()` to either download the video file or handle the blob data in the callback function you provided.

parameters.name: downloadOrCallback
parameters.comment: Either `true` to download the video, or provide a callback function to handle the Blob data, when recording is completed.

parameters.name: filetype
parameters.comment: video format. Default is "webm".

parameters.name: bitrate
parameters.comment: bitrate per second

tags.text: `let rec = space.recorder(true); rec.start(); setTimeout( () => rec.stop(), 5000); // record 5s of video and download the file`

signatures.comment: Set whether the rendering should be repainted on each frame.

parameters.name: b
parameters.comment: a boolean value to set whether to repaint each frame

signatures.comment: Remove a player from this Space.

parameters.name: player
parameters.comment: an IPlayer that has an `animateID` property

signatures.comment: Remove all players from this Space.
Custom rendering.

parameters.name: context
parameters.comment: rendering context

signatures.comment:
Replay the animation after [`Space.stop`](#link). This resets the end-time counter.
You may also use [`Space.pause`](#link) and [`resume`](#link) for temporary pause.

This overrides Space's `resize` function. It's used as a callback function for window's resize event and not usually called directly. You can keep track of resize events with `resize: (bound ,evt)` callback in your player objects.

parameters.name: b
parameters.comment: a Bound object to resize to

parameters.name: evt
parameters.comment: Optionally pass a resize event

signatures.comment: Resume the pause animation.
Set up various options for CanvasSpace. The `opt` parameter is an object with the following fields. This is usually set during instantiation, eg `new CanvasSpace(...).setup( { opt } )`

parameters.name: opt
parameters.comment: a [`CanvasSpaceOptions`](#link) object with optional settings, ie `{ bgcolor:string, resize:boolean, retina:boolean, offscreen:boolean, pixelDensity:number }`. Note that omitting `bgcolor` sets a transparent background (a long-standing behavior that differs from `DOMSpace.setup`, which keeps the current background when the option is absent).

signatures.comment: Specify when the animation should stop: immediately, after a time period, or never stops.

parameters.name: t
parameters.comment: a value in millisecond to specify a time period to play before stopping, or `-1` to play forever, or `0` to end immediately. Default is 0 which will stop the animation immediately.

signatures.comment: A convenient method to convert the touch points in a touch event to an array of Pts.
signatures.returns_comment: an array of Pt, whose origin position (0,0) is offset to the top-left of this space

parameters.name: evt
parameters.comment: a touch event which contains touches, changedTouches, and targetTouches list

parameters.name: which
parameters.comment: a string to select a touches list: "touches", "changedTouches", or "targetTouches". Default is "touches"

signatures.comment:
Track one or more [`UI`](#link) elements: every pointer, touch, and keyboard
action dispatched by this space is forwarded to them via [`UI.track`](#link),
so no manual `action` wiring is needed. Remember to also bind the events,
eg via [`MultiTouchSpace.bindMouse`](#link). Keyboard actions are forwarded
too (their x/y carry the shift/alt flags, as the space dispatches them).

parameters.name: uis
parameters.comment: a UI, or an array of UIs

signatures.comment: Unbind a callback from the event listener.

parameters.name: evt
parameters.comment: an event string such as "mousedown"

parameters.name: callback
parameters.comment: callback function to unbind

parameters.name: options
parameters.comment: options for [removeEventListener](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/EventTarget/addEventListener). This should match the options set in bindCanvas.

parameters.name: customTarget
parameters.comment: If customTarget is set in bindCanvas, you'll need to pass the same instance here to unbind

signatures.comment: Stop tracking one or more [`UI`](#link) elements added via [`MultiTouchSpace.track`](#link).

parameters.name: uis
parameters.comment: a UI or an array of UIs to remove from tracking, or omit to stop tracking all
